items.title: CFTC staffing falls 21% as crypto and prediction markets expand
items.content_text: - **CFTC staffing falls 21% as crypto and prediction markets expand** — CFTC staffing was 21% below its 10-year average by the end of 2025, while enforcement actions fell by nearly 80% in 2025. The decline comes as prediction-market volume reached $188 billion in Q3 2026, raising questions about oversight capacity. ([Coin Edition](https://coinedition.com/cftc-shrinks-workforce-as-crypto-and-prediction-markets-expand/))
